One more thing…

There's a secret message just for you.

I’ve been thinking about how hard you work and how much effort you put into everything you do, especially your studies. Honestly, I wanted to be open with you about something—I’ve actually had feelings for you for some time now. Getting to know you and seeing how special you are has made me appreciate you more than you probably realize.

I didn’t tell you this to put any pressure on you, though. My main goal right now is just to make sure you know that you have someone in your corner. Whenever school gets heavy or life becomes too much, I want to be that safe space for you. If you ever need to rant, cry, complain, or just talk through a bad day, my door is always open.

You’re doing so much better than you give yourself credit for, and you deserve all the support in the world. Just remember that no matter what comes up, I’m right here, ready to listen whenever you need me.
